paraphrase: There are one hundred and eighty kinds of kriyāvādins, eighty-four of akriyāvādins, sixty-seven of ajñānikas and thirty-two of vainayikas.

original.text: asiyasayaṃ kiriyāṇaṃ akiriyavāīṇa hoi culasīī / annāṇiya sattaṭṭhī veṇaiyāṇaṃ ca battīsā
original.edition: as quoted in the Abhidhāna-rājendra (checked locally)
